e.title: SEADRIF
e.summary: 东南亚灾害风险保险基金（SEADRIF）：东盟+3 的区域灾害保险设施
e.body: SEADRIF（Southeast Asia Disaster Risk Insurance Facility，东南亚灾害风险保险基金）是东盟+3（ASEAN 10 国 + 中日韩）推动的区域灾害风险保险设施：为东南亚各国提供灾害保险技术/产品/能力建设——区域级防灾保险合作。对 RIAA：区域灾害保险的治理与产品视角——理解「跨国灾害保险设施」如何运作（同 [[idf-open-model-library]] 的普惠保险、[[aegis-parametric]] 的参数保险谱系）；东南亚台风/洪水风险（[[ibtracs]]）的区域保险方案；普惠/气候保险研究（[[rim533]]/气候风险课程）的区域案例。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：SEADRIF 官网确认（东盟+3 区域灾害保险设施），未深测
e.summary_en: Southeast Asia Disaster Risk Insurance Facility: the ASEAN+3 regional disaster-insurance facility
e.summary_hk: 東南亞災害風險保險基金（SEADRIF）：東盟+3 的區域災害保險設施
e.body_en: SEADRIF (Southeast Asia Disaster Risk Insurance Facility) is a regional disaster-risk insurance facility driven by ASEAN+3 (ASEAN 10 + China/Japan/Korea): providing disaster-insurance technology, products and capacity building to Southeast Asian countries — regional-level disaster-insurance cooperation. For RIAA: the governance and product view of regional disaster insurance — understand how 'cross-border disaster-insurance facilities' operate (sharing the inclusive-insurance lineage of [[idf-open-model-library]] and the parametric lineage of [[aegis-parametric]]); regional insurance solutions for Southeast-Asian typhoon/flood risk ([[ibtracs]]); a regional case for inclusive/climate-insurance research ([[rim533]]/climate-risk courses).
e.body_hk: SEADRIF（Southeast Asia Disaster Risk Insurance Facility，東南亞災害風險保險基金）是東盟+3（ASEAN 10 國 + 中日韓）推動的區域災害風險保險設施：為東南亞各國提供災害保險技術/產品/能力建設——區域級防災保險合作。對 RIAA：區域災害保險的治理與產品視角——理解「跨國災害保險設施」如何運作（同 [[idf-open-model-library]] 的普惠保險、[[aegis-parametric]] 的參數保險譜系）；東南亞颱風/洪水風險（[[ibtracs]]）的區域保險方案；普惠/氣候保險研究（[[rim533]]/氣候風險課程）的區域案例。
